title: Abaad huvi Karbobala, ujjda Madina, barbaad huvi main
body:
Abaad huvi Karbobala, ujjda Madina, barbaad huvi main
Zainab ko na raas aaya Moharram ka mahinaa
<<MINI>>
Barbaad huvi main
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek din tha, kay is sheher ki karthi thi main shaahi
Aur aaj tabaahi
Bey ghusl padaa mohrey Nabuwath ka nagina
<<MINI>>
Barbaad huvi main
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis laash pay rovoon kisey choddoon main baraadar
Laashey hain bahaathar
Hadh yeh hai kay ronay ki ijaazath bhi milee na
<<MINI>>
Barbaad huvi main
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar ka galaa bhaayi ka sar, seena-e-Akbar
Sab gauhar-o-chaadar
Is dashth mai loota gayaa Zainab ka khazeena.
<<MINI>>
Barbaad huvi main
<<DIVIDER>>
Maayein bhi na pehchaan saki, bachchoun kay chehray
Bikhrey huvey sehray
Hai khoon kay daryaa main ghareeboun ka safeena.
<<MINI>>
Barbaad huvi main
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek aag hai, khaimoun mai qayaamath ka samaa hai
Ghazi tu kahaan hai
Dekho toh ridaa chheen gaya, shimr kameena
<<MINI>>
Barbaad huvi main
<<DIVIDER>>
Chaadar cheeni, durr leyliye ab zulm na dhaao
Baba sey milaao
Naizey kay taleh bhaitt kay rothi hai Sakina
<<MINI>>
Barbaad huvi main
<<DIVIDER>>
Paabandh-e rasan bibiyaan bazaar khuley sar
Har modd pey patthar
Masoom yateemoun ka bahaa. Surkh paseena
<<MINI>>
Barbaad huvi main
<<DIVIDER>>
Shoukath sar-e-maqtal yeh kaha bintey Ali ney
Zehra ki palee ney
Bhaiyya teray bin khwaab teri behnaa ka jeena
<<MINI>>
Barbaad huvi main
